description: Conflicting authorized decisions at the same instant (also written in different UTC offsets, and three at once): file order decides and the conflict is reported; same-instant agreement or an ignored attempt is no conflict.

s02.note: 15:00Z is one second after the cutoff (14:59:59Z)

s03.note: 17:00+02:00 is the same instant as 15:00Z, after the cutoff

Pricing page.note: Both decisions take effect exactly at the cutoff, which is inclusive; they are the same instant, so file order puts Ana's reject last.

Loyalty points.note: Only the customer's request so far.

Pricing page.note: Nothing later; the order-chosen reject stands.

Referral program.note: Three decisions at 12:00Z; file order applies approve, reject, approve, so Ana's approve is last.

Partner API.note: Zhou's approve won the 10-04 tie by file order; Ana's reject two days later replaces it.

Loyalty points.note: The account manager's approves, one at the same instant as Zhou's reject, are ignored.

Search.note: Two approves at the same instant agree; the later in file order is the last decision.
